---
name: Bug report
about: twinbuild gave a wrong, missing or confusing result
labels: bug
---

**Command**
`twinbuild ... -- <your build command>`

**What you expected vs what happened**
(e.g. a cause was missed, a file was blamed on the wrong cause, a crash)

**Evidence**
The `--json` output or the relevant part of the text report (redact anything private).

**Environment**
OS, Node version (`node -v`), twinbuild version (`twinbuild --version`), toolchain being built.
